source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Σιλβανός ο Ταβεννησιώτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the same day on which saint.gr keeps Pachomius the Great, beside whom the page puts him. **He is none of the eight Silvanuses the corpus already holds**: the apostle, the martyrs of Cibalae, Emesa, Gaza, Palestine, the companion of Bianor, and the two named by their days — none of them an ascetic of Tabennisi in the Upper Thebaid, and this one is neither a martyr nor an apostle. **The whole of what saint.gr prints is two sentences**, which are the whole of the life here. **No hymn, no year, no relics, no place of birth.**
